# Where to Watch Lily's Driftwood Bay


by Angel | November 19, 2026


What if a seashell, a piece of driftwood, or a curious treasure that washed up on the beach could lead to a whole new adventure? For 5-year-old Lily, it can! In *Lily’s Driftwood Bay* , everyday discoveries spark extraordinary adventures in a magical island world that exists in Lily’s imagination.


With colorful, handcrafted animation and a fresh adventure in every episode, *Lily’s Driftwood Bay* is a delightful series full of creativity and wonder.


[Stream all 52 episodes of Season 1 of Lily's Driftwood Bay now on Angel!](https://www.angel.com/watch/lilys-driftwood-bay)


### **A Whimsical World Made From Imagination**


One of the things that makes *Lily’s Driftwood Bay* so charming is its distinctive art style. The colorful world has a handmade, collage-like look, with characters and scenery that feel as if they’ve been put together from all sorts of treasures. It’s a fitting style for a show where ordinary things become extraordinary through imagination.


### **A New Adventure Washed Ashore Every Day**


With 52 episodes in Season 1, there’s plenty to explore with Lily and Gull. Each story begins with something new arriving on the beach, giving Lily another chance to imagine, explore, and make a new discovery.


Parents and kids alike have found plenty to love about the series. Angel Guild members have called it “delightful,” “cute and imaginative,” and exactly the kind of show they’d love to share with their children and grandchildren.


### **Watch** ***Lily’s Driftwood Bay*** **on Angel**


A little treasure can lead to a big adventure when you see the world through Lily’s eyes. Join Lily and Gull for 52 imaginative adventures filled with friendship, creativity, and seaside magic.


[Stream all 52 episodes of Season 1 of Lily’s Driftwood Bay now on Angel!](https://www.angel.com/watch/lilys-driftwood-bay)
